bom_recipes_component_xor.name: bom_recipes_component_xor
bom_recipes_component_xor.value: ("bom_recipes"."component_type" = 'RAW_MATERIAL' and "bom_recipes"."raw_material_id" is not null and "bom_recipes"."component_menu_item_id" is null) or ("bom_recipes"."component_type" = 'SEMI_FG' and "bom_recipes"."component_menu_item_id" is not null and "bom_recipes"."raw_material_id" is null and "bom_recipes"."component_menu_item_id" <> "bom_recipes"."menu_item_id")

expenses_void_audit.name: expenses_void_audit
expenses_void_audit.value: ("branch_expenses"."status" = 'POSTED' and "branch_expenses"."void_reason" is null and "branch_expenses"."voided_by_id" is null and "branch_expenses"."voided_at" is null) or ("branch_expenses"."status" = 'VOID' and "branch_expenses"."void_reason" is not null and length(trim("branch_expenses"."void_reason")) >= 3 and "branch_expenses"."voided_by_id" is not null and "branch_expenses"."voided_at" is not null)

leave_approval_pay.name: leave_approval_pay
leave_approval_pay.value: ("workforce_leaves"."status"='APPROVED' and "workforce_leaves"."pay_type" is not null) or ("workforce_leaves"."status"<>'APPROVED' and "workforce_leaves"."pay_type" is null)
